title: Cross-SID clean-root assurance clone rejection

source_observation.environment: Windows exact C32 full no-reuse calibration on dev 529ebeaa with Factorio 2.1.13
source_observation.fact: The assurance self-test rejected its source repository as dubious ownership when the workspace .git directory owner SID differed from the executing operator SID.

reproducer.expected: The clean-root equivalence test creates independent LF and CRLF clones and compares canonical plans.
reproducer.observed: Git rejected C:\Projects\Factorio\more-infinite-research\.git as dubious ownership before the LF clone was created.

regression_obligations: cross-SID source clone succeeds without global Git configuration
LF and CRLF clean roots retain identical plan material
fixed_point_restart_scope: all target assurance proofs produced after this harness correction; no package shadow restart

admission.reason: The failure is reproduced, bounded to test-process Git trust, and fixed without changing product or package bytes.

closure.evidence: validation/tests/tooling/Test-MIRAssurance.ps1 passed the cross-SID LF/CRLF clean-root equivalence regression on 2026-08-09
